alignments.note: Substantival article before a participle supplies the pronoun and nothing else (rule 32).
Participle rendered as a finite clause: supplied when, subject, auxiliary and object are its helpers, and further realizes the προσ- preverb (rules 86, 106).
Finite verb rendered let … go, headed on the word glossing the releasing; discontinuous around the object under rule 15.
Nominalizing article before the indirect question; English spells no word for it (rules 23, 61).
Subjunctive with its supplied subject and modal, headed on the lexical verb.
Preposition rendered by the contiguous multiword because of, headed on the prepositional word.
Substantival quantifier expanded with the generic noun men; head on the quantifier (rule 17).
Article before θεός with no English determiner (rule 23).

Substantival article before a participle keeps only the pronoun that, the relativizer going to the participle (rule 32). The ASV writes two English words here, so rule 90's single-relativizer relaxation does not reach it. The competing reading takes that which whole on the article, citing rule 77's finding that τὸ → that which heads on that; that finding is about the head and not about the unit's edge, and rule 22 sends the participle case to rule 32 in terms.
Participle with its supplied relativizer and copula, headed on the lexical verb (rules 31, 32).

review_notes: Corrected τῷ γεγονότι: the accepted alignment gave the article that which and the participle a bare was done. Rule 32 gives the article the pronoun and nothing else, and rule 90 relaxes that only where the ASV writes one English word for the pair; here it writes two, so the relativizer which goes to the participle with its copula.

This brings 4:21 into line with the chapter's four other article-before-participle units — 4:4, 4:21's own οἱ, 4:24 and 4:32 — and with 4:32 and 4:34, where an article that also supplies a nominal still leaves the relativizer to the participle.

Everything else in the verse is unchanged, including the supplied object them at t008 folded onto προσαπειλησάμενοι under rule 74's object clause, and πάντες → all men headed on the quantifier under rule 17.
